title: Offices of one service, by area
description: The desks of one service across Napoli (offices/<list>.json: the Municipalità's sede, the ASL's Prevenzione Collettiva, the ASL district's sede...), keyed by every value of a vault field: municipalità (1-10) or ASL Napoli 1 Centro distretto (24/73, 25-33), the values the vault lists for it. A procedure's desk channel names the list and the field (office: { list: comune-municipalita, from: residenza.municipalita }) and a reader picks the person's office. The file is named for its service, so a list says what it serves, not only where

field.description: The vault field's name the keys are values of

name.description: What these offices are, as the procedures call them

serves.description: What these offices handle, in Italian, so nobody takes them for another service of the same area ("igiene pubblica per le attività: corsi e attestato alimentarista", not "l'ASL del distretto")
